profile.headline: Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer with experience for over 10 years in Visual Basic used for machine automation, I use JavaScript for automating experiment analysis workflows and manipulating the UI in FlowJo. I currently focus on using Node + Express.js for the backend in apps and React.js for the Frontend. Competencies include JavaScript, Python, HTML, and CSS. My GitHub: https://github.com/mcodemax

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES:
LANGUAGES : JavaScript -- Python -- SQL -- HTML -- CSS
FRONT END: jQuery -- React -- Sass
BACK END: Flask -- Node.js -- Express -- REST
DATABASES: PostgreSQL
DEVELOPMENT AND DEPLOYMENT: Git -- Github
TESTING: Jest -- React Testing Library -- Jasmine

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed software in Python to return user data and logs from servers, ensuring high-quality and efficient performance.
• Created RPM packages to deploy software onto multiple machines within the organization.
• Utilized Jenkins and Github to manage code repositories and automate software builds and deployments.
• Demonstrated strong customer service skills by promptly addressing and resolving issues reported by customers through Jira tickets

positions.title: Bioprocess Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked cross-functionally across Engineering, QA, and customer facing teams to deliver a higher product standards.
•	Designed code for dispensing robot automation in Visual Basic/VBScript, and made Flowjo analysis scripts in Javascript to organization experimental data and streamline analysis.
•	Troubleshot Java related cytometer issues errors and developed work-arounds for a better user experience.
•	Trained other Bioengineers on software such as FlowJo and FACSDiva to improve QC and Product Support workflow.

positions.title: Sr Associate Quality Control
positions.description:
•	Performed various immunoassays of in-process, stability and final manufactured drug samples using techniques, such as Bioassays under cGMPs, GDP and GLP guidelines.
•	Followed correct and proper documentation in an Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN) to summarize and report data from experiments.
•	Managed drug samples and test results, including documentation, based on Amgen and cGMP regulations.
•	Worked collaboratively and efficiently in a team-based environment and with other departments

positions.title: QC Associate I
positions.description:
•	Imported large data sets from Flowjo and FCSExpress into Excel for data analysis from up to 100+ samples in one experiment for product investigations.
•	Created templates in Flowjo and FCSExpress for experiment analysis optimization.
•	Wrote technical reports based on troubleshooting customer complaints on products and various reagents.
•	Collaborated between departments and presented/interpreted data in troubleshooting experiments to determine course of action for reagent release based on stability data by strict deadlines.
•	Tested reagents in adherence to QC Standards before release to market.

positions.title: Scientist I
positions.description:
•	Worked in laboratory with murine, human, and monkey tissues in preparation for experiments.
•	Assisted in reagent development and evaluation and used established company procedures in evaluation.
•	Carefully planned and scheduled experiments on tissues and cells lines to meet testing deadlines.
•	Executed experiments independently and presented data.
•	Performed experiments in multi-parameter flow cytometry, cell stimulation and cell culture assays.
•	Used FCSExpress and MS Office Suite to analyze data from flow cytometry experiments.

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description: • Tutored Lower Division Chemistry, Linear Algebra, Physics, Vector Calculus

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• Analyzed experimental data from deformation and cell adhesion/contraction experiments.
• 3T3 Cell Culturing, TGF-Beta1 Experimentation.
• Use assays such as ASMA detection for protein detection in experiments.
• Presented 3T3 Fibroblast to Myofibroblast transformation poster at AISES National Conference

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
•	Assisted with assignment preparation, classroom environment optimization, and grading.
•	Tutored 2nd grade students while working on improving their self-confidence in mathematics.

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description: • Rotated roles between cashier, customer, and dining services.

projects.title: Foodyuh - A portfolio for your plate.
projects.description:
A website where users can create a several plates or "Portfolios" of food and have a nutritional analysis of all combined foods within a plate.

•	Built a nutrition analyzer app using ReactJS, Formik, and SCSS creating a responsive UI/UX design.
•	Integrated multiple third party APIs to generate nutrition data and images associated with foods.
•	Aggregated data from FDC API to analyze nutrition from all foods in a user’s “plate”.
•	Constructed a RESTful API designed with Node and Express with CRUD functionality for client requests.
•	Enabled back-end storage for users to access their plate and user info with Express and PostgreSQL.
•	Created Front-end and Back-end tests using Jest and React Testing Library to detect and prevent future bugs.

projects.title: Stocker
projects.description:
A website where users can create a portfolio up to 5 stocks and calculate the near real time value of their portfolio holdings. Users can view daily chart price history of stock holding in their portfolio. Disclaimer: Due to free API limits from AlphaVantage App performs best is waiting 30-60s before viewing portfolios and altering them.

•	Built a Stock Market Portfolio application which utilized the AlphaVantage and ChartJS APIs to display a user’s portfolio performance in real time.
•	Constructed a RESTful API designed with Flask and Python with CRUD functionality for client requests.
•	Utilized Axios, JavaScript, ChartJS API, and CSS to generate company stock performance history on the UI.
•	Enabled back-end storage for users to access their portfolio and user info via SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL.
•	Used using the Alpha Vantage API to generate real time stock price data for a dynamic application.
•	Created unit and integration tests for back-end routes, and rendered pages via Python.
